_how_to_use: Start with every criterion false — that is the correct starting state, not an unfinished one. false means "not claimed": either not done, or done but not yet checked. Set one to true only after you have read the code and confirmed it is genuinely true today.

criteria.text: Given the Command Center, when it is opened, then every tab is reachable and every card drills down one level.
Given sample mode, when any tab is shown, then the sample data is visibly labelled as sample.

Given the Command Center, when any tab renders, then .colaberry/plan.json and .colaberry/progress.json are both committed in this repo and every tab reads its content from them at runtime rather than from hard-coded values.
Given the Command Center, when any tab is shown, then .colaberry/manifest.json is committed in this repo and every tab shows how old that data is and warns when the age exceeds a week.
Trust — no tab shows a number, a connection or a result the project has not actually produced.
Given a new company setup request, when I enter company details, then the system creates a company profile.
Given an incomplete company setup request, when I try to save, then the system prompts for missing information.
Trust: All company setup actions are logged in the audit trail.
Given a request to add an account, when I provide valid account details, then the system adds it to the chart of accounts.
Given a request to add an account with invalid details, when I try to save, then the system rejects the request.
Trust: All changes to the chart of accounts are logged in the audit trail.
Given a journal entry request, when I enter valid debit and credit amounts, then the system records the entry.
Given an unbalanced journal entry request, when I try to save, then the system rejects the entry.
Trust: All journal entries are logged in the audit trail.
Transactions can be posted to the general ledger.
A trial balance can be generated from posted transactions.
An income statement and balance sheet can be produced.
Unbalanced transactions are rejected before posting.
Every financial transaction is recorded in an audit trail.
Customer and vendor profiles can be created and maintained.
Accounts receivable and payable can be tracked and settled.
Sales and purchasing transactions can be recorded end to end.
Cash and bank transactions can be recorded and reconciled.
Users can be assigned roles that gate what they can access.
Inventory items and stock levels can be tracked.
Budgets and cost centers can be created and tracked.
Branch-level operations can be configured and managed.
Operational and financial dashboards are available.
AI-generated analysis is available and requires approval before altering records.
Multi-branch operations are supported at scale.
Data can be imported and exported via Excel or CSV.
